# mimux

> A self-hosted email gateway: connect any IMAP mailbox and reach it through
> every interface — a fast, free web client (AGPL-3.0) for humans, and a paid
> automation layer (REST API, MCP server, CLI, signed webhooks; GraphQL on the
> roadmap) for scripts and AI agents. One Go binary, one SQLite file, on your
> own hardware ({{price:annual:eur}}/yr or {{price:perpetual:eur}} perpetual, per instance, 14-day free trial).

## Pages

- [Features](https://mimux.dev/features/): unified inbox, IMAP IDLE sync, deep search, Markdown compose with undo-send, server-side filters, PWA with encrypted push.
- [Automation & APIs](https://mimux.dev/agents/): the MCP server at /api/mcp, the REST API with OpenAPI spec, the CLI, signed webhooks, scoped tokens, two-step sending.
- [Pricing](https://mimux.dev/pricing/): free client forever; pro {{price:annual:eur}}/yr or {{price:perpetual:eur}} perpetual per instance; offline Ed25519 licence verification, no phone-home.
- [About](https://mimux.dev/about/): built by Matteo Merola (Merola Software & Services, Zurich); the published free/pro line and why it can't move.
- [Security](https://mimux.dev/security/): how to report vulnerabilities privately, scope, and mimux's security posture.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.mimux.dev): install, configuration, OAuth setup and the API reference (rendered from the OpenAPI spec the binary serves).

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux): the full source, AGPL-3.0 client plus the ELv2 pro layer.
- [LICENSING.md](https://github.com/mattmezza/mimux/blob/main/LICENSING.md): which directory is under which licence, and how `make verify-free` proves the split.

## Purchase

- [Account portal](https://account.mimux.dev): licence purchase (Stripe) and key retrieval by email.

## Contact

- [Support](mailto:support@mimux.dev): general contact and licences. `mimux` is a trademark of Matteo Merola.
